name: What is the typical cost per square foot for flooring installation in a foreclosed property?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost per square foot for flooring installation in a foreclosed property?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of flooring installation in a foreclosed property varies significantly based on material, labor rates, and subfloor preparation needs. For basic laminate or LVP, you might expect to pay $3-$7 per square foot. Mid-range options like engineered hardwood or higher-quality LVP can range from $7-$12 per square foot. Hardwood flooring can start at $10-$20+ per square foot. These figures typically include materials and professional installation but exclude extensive subfloor repairs or removal of old flooring. Getting a detailed quote is essential.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs range from $3-$7 per square foot for basic options like laminate or LVP, up to $10-$20+ for hardwood. This includes materials and installation.
